name: shariah-stock-watch
description: Web app for viewing prices and charts of Shariah-screened stocks

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
